response.sql:
WITH matched_scans AS (
  SELECT 
    scans.zoneref,
    sites.riskeval,
    scans.pressratio
  FROM scans
  INNER JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry
),
grouped_data AS (
  SELECT
    zoneref,
    riskeval,
    AVG(pressratio) as avg_compression_ratio,
    COUNT(*) as num_scans
  FROM matched_scans
  GROUP BY zoneref, riskeval
),
with_totals AS (
  SELECT
    zoneref,
    riskeval,
    avg_compression_ratio,
    num_scans,
    num_scans * 1.0 / SUM(num_scans) OVER () as share
  FROM grouped_data
)
SELECT
  zoneref,
  riskeval,
  avg_compression_ratio,
  num_scans,
  share
FROM with_totals
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The 'share of all matched scans' is the count of scans in each (zoneref, riskeval) group divided by the total count of all scans after the INNER JOIN, expressed as a decimal (not a percentage).
NULL values in scans.pressratio are ignored when calculating the average compression ratio (standard AVG() behavior).
